plugins.name: burn-meter
plugins.description: Live pane showing session spend, $/h burn rate with a 1-hour sparkline, an optional budget with alerts, tokens and estimated cost per model, context fill and rate-limit reset countdowns.

plugins.name: file-trail
plugins.description: Live repo file tree that lights up each file and folder Claude reads, edits, writes or searches, as it happens. Opens only the branches Claude touched, with R/E/W/S marks and counts.

plugins.name: browser-trail
plugins.description: Live timeline of the browser tool calls Claude makes while testing a web app (Playwright MCP, Chrome DevTools MCP, Claude in Chrome, agent-browser): action, target, page, OK/ERROR/TIMEOUT and duration. Observed vs correlated facts are marked, and inputs are redacted. Observe-only.

plugins.name: model-pilot
plugins.description: Routes a task to a fitting model, or to a small team of subagents when it splits into independent parts. Agents share context through a versioned artifact store, and a live dashboard shows radial progress, agent lanes, a data-flow graph and the router's reasoning. Nothing starts before you approve in recommend mode.
